sentences.text: 7. Counsel for the pe oner argued that pe oner is not in touch with Kamal Kumar and has been separated.
8. On this, Ms. Swa Batra, D.A.G., Punjab, submits that they have got instruc ons that the main accused usually visit a?er 10-15 days where pe oner-Poonam Rani is staying.

9. To this counsel for the pe oner submits that Kamal Kumar has two children, a daughter aged 16 years and a son aged 10 years, who are staying with pe oner- Poonam Rani and visits are primarily to meet the children not to the pe oner.

10. An analysis of above argument points out that there is probability that pe oner is staying separately from Kamal Kumar and she has two minor children, one of whom is a daughter, aged 16 years, who is in a very vulnerable age and coupled with the fact that money was transferred in Kamal Kumar's account and not in pe oner's account, as such, she is en tled to an cipatory bail.
11. Given above, the present pe on is allowed and interim order dated 07.03.2024 is made absolute.
All pending miscellaneous applica ons, if any, stand disposed of.
